modelDescription: Experience the latest in nighttime exploration technology with the Hexcore HD 1-3x Digital Night Vision Binoculars. Equipped with a high-performance 1280x720 CMOS digital night vision sensor, these binoculars deliver exceptional clarity, allowing you to see the nocturnal world like never before. The 640x360 TFT LCD display enhances contrast, ensuring crystal-clear imagery that brings every detail to life. Capture your adventures with the built-in video recorder, capable of recording HD 1280x720 resolution footage for up to 11 hours. With nighttime recording capabilities extending beyond 150 yards, you won't miss a moment even in the darkest environments. Unleash your inner photographer with the HD 1280x720 photo resolution, saving your stunning images in JPEG format. The Hexcore's 1-3x digital zoom brings distant objects closer, enabling detailed exploration, while its integrated IR illuminator with 2200mW of power on high mode ensures clear visibility even in complete darkness. Powered by four included AA batteries, the Hexcore HD offers up to 8 hours of continuous daytime use. Whether you're venturing out during the day or night, these binoculars adapt to any lighting conditions and settings. The included DNV head mount allows you to convert them into night vision goggles, providing a hands-free experience.
